rig_contract.skinning: none; rigid nested pivots, no animation clips

digits.pivots: one rigid pivot per digit at the knuckle (Thumb = CMC, fingers = MCP), child of Hand.L/R; rest pose = identity = relaxed curl built into the phalanges
digits.axes: curl = rotation.x (positive closes towards the palm); spread = rotation.z (positive tilts the tip towards glTF +X)
digits.anchors: anchor_tip_<digit>_<L|R> under each digit pivot; anchor_fingertips_<L|R> (legacy name) is now under Middle.<L|R>
digits.lod: LOD0: one ceramic primitive per digit (posable); LOD1/LOD2: digits fused into the Hand mesh, pivots and anchors kept so poses never reference a missing node

relaxed.note: rest pose (identity); also the seated palms-on-table pose (fingertips meet the table plane)

flat.note: fingers opened slightly for a flat-hand gesture

point.note: index extended, others folded; point at the instrument / a guest

grip.note: closed around anchor_grip (cup handle, folio edge)

material_prefixes.Eyes: emissive agent colour; blink by mesh scale.y (origin on eye centre line)

rig_contract.mouth: Head-local glTF (0,-0.085,0.307) is free for the runtime voice mouth; no Head_Brass mesh, so replaceFixedHeroMouth() is a no-op
rig_contract.rotation_sign: joint angles are rotation about the node local X (three.js rotation.x); negative swings forward

seated_at_arrival_table.description: robot placed at a chair anchor_seat with the root lowered; soles on the floor, palms flat on the table 0.38 m in front of the root

ensemble.legacy_runtime_note: habitatLayout.ts currently places the old table scaled 1.2 (r 1.34, top 0.99) with ORCHESTRATOR_TABLE_SEAT 1.9 m from its centre and a standing-height seated body. This ensemble is lower and tighter so the robot really sits: W6 must move the seat to 1.25 m and use r 1.0 / h 0.60 colliders when adopting it.
